evals.prompt: Make my 5h, 7d, and Fable bars 8, 10, and 14 cells long and preview it.
evals.expected_output: Updates only active profile widths, validates ranges, and previews all three bars.

evals.prompt: Put Fable first, hide disk and tmp, and make the line fit my split pane with a 3-cell bar floor.
evals.expected_output: Reorders and filters segments, sets fit.min_bar_cells to 3, explains that percentages always use the bar heat colour, preserves unrelated configuration.

evals.prompt: Turn on automatic refit when I resize the terminal.
evals.expected_output: Sets fit.resize_watch to true, explains the settings.json nonce write and the roughly two-second latency, offers refreshInterval as the zero-write alternative.

evals.prompt: Uninstall the custom Claude status line but keep every other setting.
evals.expected_output: Removes only owned status-line configuration and disables the plugin.

evals.prompt: Show a countdown to when my 5h limit resets.
evals.expected_output: Sets resets_format to countdown (resets true) via scripts/resets-toggle --format countdown or /statusline-resets countdown, preserves other keys, and mentions that countdown sets statusLine.refreshInterval to 60 when the status line is claude-statusline's own.
